<section>Chapter 30. "V" Standard Extension for Vector Operations, Version 1.0 > 30.18. Standard Vector Extensions > 30.18.2. Zve*: Vector Extensions for Embedded Processors</section>
<previous> extensions support all vector fixed-point arithmetic instructions (Section 30.12), except that `vsmul.vv` and `vsmul.vx` are not included in EEW=64 in Zve64*.

 _As with multiplies are relatively rare._ `vmulh` _,_ `vsmul` _requires a large amount of additional logic, and 64-bit fixed-point_

All Zve* extensions support all vector integer single-width and widening reduction operations (Section 30.14.1, Section 30.14.2).

All Zve* extensions support all vector mask instructions (Section 30.15).</previous>
<target>All Zve* extensions support all vector permutation instructions (Section 30.16), except that Zve32x and Zve64x do not include those with floating-point operands, and Zve64f does not include those with EEW=64 floating-point operands.

The Zve32x extension depends on the Zicsr extension. The Zve32f and Zve64f extensions depend upon the F extension, and implement all vector floating-point instructions (Section 30.13) for floatingpoint operands with EEW=32. Vector single-width floating-point reduction operations (Section 30.14.3) for EEW=32 are supported.

The Zve64d extension depends upon the D extension, and implements all vector floating-point instructions (Section 30.13) for floating-point operands with EEW=32 or EEW=64 (including widening instructions and conversions between FP32 and FP64). Vector single-width floating-point reductions (Section 30.14.3) for EEW=32 and EEW=64 are supported as well as widening reductions from FP32 to FP64.</target>
